document_identity.meaning: Role of the contractual document, such as endorsement/amendment.
Identifier of the insurance contract affected by the document.
Insurer product identifier printed with the contract reference.
Date on which the contractual modification takes effect.

insured_object.meaning: Registration identifier of the insured vehicle.
First registration/in-service date of the insured vehicle.
Declared engine displacement of the insured vehicle.

coverage.meaning: List of guarantees/coverages explicitly subscribed in the special terms.

declared_driver.meaning: Identity of the habitual or declared driver.
Birth date of the declared driver.
Driving-licence issue date declared for the driver.

premium_and_adjustment.meaning: Annual reference premium before reduction/majoration and ancillary guarantees/taxes where specified.
Annual premium at the effective date after the stated reduction/majoration coefficient.
Period to which an announced premium refund applies.
Amount of premium announced as refundable for the stated period.

contractual_context.meaning: Place where the document states it was executed.
Date where the document states it was executed.
Roles expected in the signature zone, without observed personal values.

phase_1_document_identity.method: Use stable printed header labels and adjacent values; reject identity if mandatory anchors conflict.

phase_2_section_segmentation.method: Segment by visible section headings; use rendered-page reading when the PDF text layer corrupts a heading.

phase_3_label_value_extraction.method: Within the active section, extract values adjacent to explicit labels or stable contractual phrases. Prefer native text when label and value are both reliable.

phase_4_render_fallback.trigger: Expected section/label is visibly present but native text is corrupted, missing, or non-normalizable.
phase_4_render_fallback.method: Read the rendered page region for that field only; do not OCR the whole document by default.

phase_5_normalization.dates: Normalize to ISO date only when day/month/year are unambiguous.
phase_5_normalization.money: Normalize numeric amount and currency separately.
phase_5_normalization.unknown: Return explicit UNKNOWN rather than infer a missing value.

phase_6_traceability.requirement: Each extracted field must retain page number and extraction method: NATIVE_TEXT or RENDER_FALLBACK.

verification_protocol: Check each extracted value against the rendered source page.
Require source page and extraction method for each field.
Reject silently inferred values; uncertain values become UNKNOWN.
Test the candidate grammar on at least one independent same-family specimen before claiming reusable profile robustness.
When family recognition is added, include at least one meaningful negative specimen to test false acceptance.

existing.reason: Potentially useful after stable text anchors and normalized geometry have been established; not required for first-document understanding.
Useful for later family recognition only with independent reference/specimens; self-match would be circular.
Can support rendered-region extraction after a profile binding exists, but cannot by itself construct the missing profile.
Can validate output structure but not documentary truth.

missing.function: Materialize a candidate documentary profile from the instructed field semantics, section anchors, extraction grammar, normalization rules, verification protocol and reuse boundary.
Extract profile-defined fields using native PDF text where reliable and targeted rendered-page fallback only where required, with field-level provenance.

reuse_boundary.reusable_profile_requires: At least one independent same-family specimen successfully processed without case-specific reinterpretation.

limits: Instruction is based on one real specimen.
No reusable profile robustness claim is made.
No family matcher was executed or qualified.
No private values, private source path, private source hash, or raw source document are included in this result.
Some PDF text-layer labels are encoding-degraded, so targeted rendered-page fallback is part of the candidate grammar.

next_action.requirement: Provide one independent same-family specimen to test the candidate field semantics and extraction grammar before any reusable profile claim. No additional evidence is required to preserve the current documentary instruction.
